We also released a build with improvements to controller support across the board on the Steam beta (beta-beta) branch. If your controller had issues previously, it's worth trying it with the new beta build. Especially in Linux and macOS.
1. right click in art of rally in your Library
2. select Properties
3. go to the Betas tab and then select the beta branch
4. wait for the update to finish
5. verify the installation.

You may need to try different Steam input settings in the Controller tab in art of rally's Library Properties and also in the Steam Controller Settings. Make sure to restart the game each time you change any Steam settings.

If you didn't have controller issues previously, but now have them with the beta branch build, please send the game logs to the team after you try the build. For instructions, see the pinned post How to Report a Bug: https://steamcommunity.com/app/550320/discussions/0/3844431603853496606/

releases.displayName: 🎉 art of rally for Android and a major update for iOS are here! 🎉

notes.title: Strap into your seatbelts and race off with us! We're happy to announce that art of rally launches today on Google Play! Along with a major update for iOS!

items.text: This release will bring to both iOS and Android all updates and improvements to the console and PC versions of the game! As well as new custom on screen control modifications. From beginner-friendly options to driving modes that’ll challenge the most expert drivers, all players can tackle the races using their favourite rally driving tricks: Scandinavian flick, counter steering, left foot braking, and handbrake turns.
The Android version of the game will be released for $7.99 USD.
There will be a 1-week launch sale of the game at $4.99.

An update to let you all know that we will be sunsetting official DirectX 12 support over the next couple of weeks.

We initially enabled this option as a way to give more options for dealing with performance issues but we have found it hasn't meaningfully helped a large enough subset of our community to justify the ongoing maintenance costs of Unity's experimental DX12 support.
You'll still be able to manually apply the -force-d3d12 launch options going forward but know that we are no longer able to provide official support for bug fixing and maintenance to DX12 issues.
The good news is Funselektor is taking this time and putting it toward new exciting things, keep an eye out!

We’ve been laying low as we were recovering from the last couple years, but finally:
tldr: We fed the Funselektor mascot a turbocharger and now it’s MAXIMUM ATTACK!
First up, we’ve moved to a 4-day workweek and our ongoing part-time and full-time collaborators are now full-time employees (except one), so we can offer vacation, sick days and benefits!
I’m proud to announce our FULL-TIME team, a great group from around the globe. The last couple years have felt like war, by self-publishing and doing many releases.
A large reason we’ve survived through the hard times is because of these people (in order of hire date):
Adrian Tosello - Developer from Melbourne, Australia

Full-time since 2020 and helped finish art of rally, a big reason it had a solid build and little bugs at launch is because of him. He’s been doing ongoing development on art of rally, FunCore, and an unannounced game.
Perren Spence-Pearse - Technical Lead from Melbourne, Australia

Part-time since 2020, adding the dynamic crowds, optimization and graphics work. He likes to play with our hard development problems. He’ll be heading up FunCore, working on art of rally and an unannounced game.
Jacob Vincent - Technical Producer and Tools Developer from Melbourne, Australia
Part-time since 2020 to port art of rally to GOG, Livery Mods and builds. Now he’s managing our development team, and improving our development pipeline and tools that will support our developers.
Aaron Oak - Creative Producer from Los Angeles, USA

Joined in 2020 doing Community Management for our art of rally launch part-time and full-time in 2021 as Creative Producer to for bizdev, production, improving our processes and planning for our future projects.
Friedel Verpoort - Developer and Backend from Kortemark, Belgium
Joined part-time in 2020 after I asked “can you do our Epic Port for our launch next week and start tomorrow?”
And he got it done. Since then he created our servers, PC ports and is starting on unannounced game.
Boyan Bratanov - QA and Support from Pleven, Bulgaria (Part-Time)

Boyan came on our radar after he appeared in our community channels and now he is officially on the team and will continue answering questions on our public channels, QA and handling our new Support email too.

And Me - Recently I finished doing a large renovation to the Funselektor camper van and am in it again roaming around. It must be funny from the perspective of our team, but it makes me happy and is fun.
Some things never change.

To summarize, 2020 and 2021 were insanely busy for us as we’ve had many launches and growth and recently we've taken time to press the reset button and reevaluate everything we do from the ground up so we can make games better.
This is our new game-agnostic architecture for our future Unity games in order to build them more efficiently, with less bugs and higher performance.
The team has started from scratch and I've requested a checkbox for multiplayer, so it should be possible right?
DO games has been working on optimizing the Switch version of art of rally to upgrade the visual fidelity which will be available in a future update.
There are currently car livery mods, but what if there was something else, something even more creative?
Finally, shoutout to Jair McBain for putting, Adrian, Perren, and Jacob in contact with me, the game would have taken another year to ship :p
and Aaron for working with me on the remote employee project, it took forever!

This 1.2.0 update has been 6-months in the making and features a full-UI re-design by Jamie Churchman, the artist from Mini Metro, including the much requested Dark Mode and UI scaling. We've also brought our own cross-platform leaderboards online with downloadable ghosts, which means that they'll be starting from fresh.
More highlights are updated AI times, better low-end torque on all cars and better performance.
We've been working full-time on the game since it launched in September and are continuing onto more locations even after Kenya!
We hope you enjoy this update and stay tuned for the Kenya Update dropping later this Summer!

items.text: v1.0.5c build. This one has taken a little longer as we were doing some more bugfixes, but it is ready and should run a bit faster now as we've optimized the heaviest part of the game which was the vegetation.
We are still working hard on the game and have a big update coming in December! If you've enjoyed the game it would really help if you can leave a review too.

lowered the collider of the t22 so the wheels don't clip on harsh jump landings
some code optimizations
enable running the application in background when not in focus
fixes
fix bug where 'barely keeping it together' achievement was being awarded even on terminal damage stage completes
parking lot achievement no longer awarded before all cars are unlocked
fix bug where the car would keep some momentum after resetting.
fix typos in credits

potential fix for a bug that prevents players from finishing a stage by resetting them to the last waypoint when they cross the finish line
fix bug where screenshake would happen after a stage restart or offroad reset
fix bug where the car would keep some momentum after resetting.
fix incorrect reporting of stages won in custom mode

"groundhog day" bug

Trading cards are now enabled and they'll drop automatically depending on your playtime! Check out the awesome emoticons, profile backgrounds, badges and more!

Another game update today, we were dealing with some leaderboard issues. The baseline times for AI in career are based off the leaderboards as we don't have a "Stig" to set the fastest time for all 1200 leadeboard that cover each car class, weather, & stage combinations. We updated the times after launch, but it turns out there was a bug where scores were being uploaded to another leaderboard accidentally, so we've had to cull the top 30 and need to cull a lesser number today as well unfortunately.

There are some growing pains but now the game should be more stable and we can now focus on larger more fun updates with gameplay tweaks from your feedback, fixing more bugs and are working on better optimization too. All your feedback is very valuable and please tell us what you think of the new updates, we are supporting this game 100%!
Features
-reverted Ai times to pre-launch as there was an issue with incorrect leaderboard scores being uploaded
Improvements
-dakar truck & logging truck on automatic transmission downshifts at a higher rev limit
-tweaked the dakar truck & logging truck collider so the wheels don't clip in the ground on hard impacts
-Added haybales for a cuttable corner on the Sardinia san gavino monreale stage
-FPS counter show the allocated memory now
Fixes
-stage times don't upload to the wrong leadeboard if the stage gets out of sync
-fixed: double-clicking on the "continue" in the post-stage screen in Career would advance the stage index twice
-added missing rock collider on Norway Laupstad stage
-fixed uneven road on Japan freeroam
-fixed: If you repair, then restart on the stage afterwards, it resets your damage to a pre-repaired state.
-car is only dirtied when moving
-fixed Airborne achievement
-fixed: crossing the finish line while in the midst of an off-track reset would still register as finishing
And if you've enjoyed the game so far it would be great if you can leave a review on Steam!

Hey Everyone!

It's been a week since launch and it's been exciting seeing everyone's reaction to the game. Thanks for all of the bug reports and feedback. This new build is live now. We do have more bugs, tweaks and features we need to get to, so there will be more updates in the future!

updated AI times

increased downsampling on Distance Blur
lowered Bloom diffusion value so it's faster
changed AO type to deferred from camera-space

reduced terminal damage speed threshold by 6.66%
Improved Vegetation rendering

fixed slower framerate on foggy stages

removed achievement checking performance hit when going really fast
fixed incorrect livery bug

This update has been mostly about making the game prettier, namely vegetation, lighting and particles. I was deep in the hole for this one and there's many things that aren't on the changelog so you'll just have to try it out!
Features
-stages have real time ambient occlusion
-New trees, rocks, bushes and vegetation pass for all locations
-Swapped the vegetation shaders for ones that support instanced indirect, which is much faster than the previous way of rendering vegetation
Improvements
-improved gear ratios
-Group B, S, A have more even downforce between the front and rear wings which makes for more even jump flight and also less understeer when going high speeds
-redid the lighting for snow stages
-all strings are localized now
-readjusted braking power for all classes
-cars are using studded snow tires so increased the grip on snow a little bit
-nearly all the particles have been overhauled and now look much more consistent across all lighting and weather
Fixes
-manual & automatic were swapped
-weather effects that are attached to the car do not rotate with the car anymore (no more sideways rain)
-Photo mode works again
-Camera glitch between begin stage and racing
-quality & vegetation density settings were only being set with a quality setting was changed
-when coming onto the throttle the turbo blow-off sfx is stopped if it is currently playing
